articles.title: Netanyahu's unity government pivot could reshape Israeli politics, end boycott
articles.summary: Netanyahu announces his campaign strategy to end the political boycott against him and build a broader coalition ahead of elections scheduled for October 2026.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump spoke, agreed to meet in the US 'soon'
articles.summary: Netanyahu and Trump discussed US independence and agreed to meet soon in the United States, with Netanyahu emphasizing the close relationship between Israel and the US.
